honesty.ci: clip-bootstrap CI is wide; window-bootstrap OOD CI is optimistic
honesty.n: 150 windows / 7 clips / ~3 wearers, one labeller -> wide CIs
honesty.no_transfer: the IndEgo-trained model does not transfer to OOD; reported, not hidden
honesty.no_tuning: model C values are the documented ones; never tuned on a held-out clip

label_source: human IndEgo gold manifest_gold.json (one labeller, ~3 wearers); windows within a clip are correlated

ood.e103_reference_protocol: frozen IndEgo logistic trained on the E1.01 sweep 10fps features (shard_sweep), applied to the same OOD windows
ood.note_saturated: all OOD windows scored p=1.0 (the features.json scale is far outside the IndEgo training range); the value is reported, not hidden
ood.protocol: frozen IndEgo pixel26 logistic (trained on all 150 IndEgo windows, features.json) applied to the cached OOD 26-feature windows at fps=10; CI = window-bootstrap B=2000 seed0 (optimistic: ~1 window/factory)

protocol: in-domain = leave-one-clip-out (LOCO) over the 7 IndEgo clips; 95% CI = clip-level bootstrap B=1000 seed0
title: standard eval harness (PR comparison baseline)

eg2.protocol: leave-one-clip-out over the 7 IndEgo clips; EG2 embedding frozen (no fine-tune)
